new_mathematics.square_small_ball: If W has density cap L, then sup_t P(|d(W-a)^2+c-t|<rho)<=2sqrt(2)L sqrt(rho/|d|). The constant is the exact maximal preimage-length bound for x^2.
new_mathematics.overlap_safe_theorem: For Q=(Y+m(Z))^T B(Y+m(Z))+d(W(Z)-a)^2+c, where Y are two independent cap-one original coordinates, Z is the independent complement, B is invertible indefinite, D=|det B|, kappa=sigma_min(B), W has marginal density cap L, and m(Z) may depend arbitrarily on W, ||p_Q||inf<=8*2^(1/4)*L^(1/2)*(D*kappa*|d|)^(-1/4). For a normalized product projection W, L<=sqrt(2), giving 8sqrt(2)*(D*kappa*|d|)^(-1/4).
new_mathematics.rank3_corollary: For exact rank three with nonzero eigenvalue magnitudes >=s and any invertible indefinite ORIGINAL-coordinate pair B, exact Schur completion leaves lambda(h dot Z)^2 with |lambda|>=s and ||h||=1, hence ||p||inf<=8sqrt(2)*(D*kappa*s)^(-1/4). The pair translation may depend on the same complement coordinates generating h dot Z.
